messages:
Asha: starting on v2.2-int4-slim bring-up. primary goal is to validate packetized rollout with entropy/quorum guards + A/B attentiveness checks.
Marco: define "entropy/quorum" guard? i.e., monitor top-token distribution shift and require cross-slice consensus?
Asha: yes. two-tier gating: (1) entropy_shift KL <= 0.05 per slice; (2) quorum: at least 3 independent metrics (mrr, hallucination, top3-preserve) must be within thresholds, otherwise quarantine. Also auto-fallback if siren breaches.
Evelyn: thresholds suggestion: hallucination_abs_delta <= 0.01, mrr_rel_drop <= 0.008, top3_preserve_rel >= 0.9, p95_latency_mult <= 1.15. siren if hallucination >0.02 OR top3_preserve <0.8.
Asha: sample gating: require min_samples 1800 and min_users 250 per slice; for A/B compare we need paired sampling of 5k for short tests.
Marco: how does quorum work at low-sample? fallback -> quarantine-shadow? keep autopromote disabled until manual approval?
Asha: quarantine-shadow if samples < min_samples; autopromote disabled beyond 30% until manual override; escrow: keep 4% pinned to previous variant for 36h. also enable slow-regression detector (7-day rolling delta alert).
Evelyn: can deploy-bot run an A/B shadow with 15000 requests, stratified by slice (short, long, code, retrieval)? include token-cost and entropy hooks.
Asha: @deploy-bot run ab-shadow v2.2-int4-slim --samples=15000 --slices=short,long,code,retrieval --hooks=telemetry,entropy,kvcache,cost
deploy-bot: queued job id=rs-2026-04-15-22. results will land at /canary/results/1808888888. I will publish a summary and raw diffs when complete.
Marco: once diffs land let's do paired-stat tests (bootstrap) and a human review of 60 borderline cases.
Evelyn: add product/safety to the review and ensure reranker centroids are compared (cosine drop <=0.015). also verify kv-warmup hit-rate delta >= -0.04.
Asha: final config i'll put in the rollout PR including the quorum matrix and siren fast-fail. will tag you all. ping here when job starts.
